violation_type.title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities
violation_type.typical_finding: Activity plan did not include outdoor play.

finding_variants.text: Activity plan did not include outdoor play.
The children have not been outside since June 2024 for outdoor physical activity.
Caregivers are not consistently facilitating outdoor play for the children on a daily basis.
The daily schedule posted in the classroom did not offer a second outdoor time for children while in care.
Outdoor activity times were not listed on the schedule.
During inspection it was observed that children did not have outdoor playtime.

facilities.name: Wonderful World Daycare and Learning Center
C J's Little Ones Day Care
Eoac New Road Head Start/Early Head Start

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The operation failed to provide a designated group of children with their required two daily opportunities for outdoor play
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The infant schedule did not include two outdoor play opportunities or 60 minutes of outside time.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: According to the director, children still have not been outside since 5/4 due to rainy weater, damp grounds, and presence of ants.     NOTE: Review of available weather reports show no documented rain 5/11-515 or on 5/18. Pest control was not completed until 5/20

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, it has been concluded that the operation failed to provide the children from the center with the opportunity of outdoor play.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: According to the director, the last time children were outside was 5/4. There was no reported weather 5/5-5/6 that  limit outdoor play

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The written activity plans for infants is not being followed for outdoor activity time. The weather did not present a health risk or inclement weather to prevent children access to their outdoor space. The infants were walked in their evacuation crib to the gym for active play instead of outside opportunity. The infants remained in the crib and weren't provided any gross motor opportunities. They remained in the crib in the gym for less than 2 minutes before returning back to their classroom. Additionally, the older infant classroom also transitioned and used the gym space instead of the outdoor activity space.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The written activity plans for infants is not being followed for outdoor activity time. The weather did not present a health risk or inclement weather to prevent children access to their outdoor space but the children were not given any outdoor opportunities in the morning.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The toddlers did not have two outdoor opportunities scheduled and the pre-k class did not have 90 minutes of physical activities scheduled.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: At the inspection, the caregivers did not follow the daily schedule for giving children the opportunity to be outside during the morning time.
occurrences.facility_name: C J's Little Ones Day Care

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: One class did not have a second outdoor opportunity on their lesson plan, and one class only had 55 minutes of outside time scheduled on their lesson plan.
occurrences.facility_name: Eoac New Road Head Start/Early Head Start

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: In one of the toddler classrooms, there is only one opportunity for outdoor play listed on the activity schedule. Additionally, the activity plan in the infant room says that some babies might  be sleeping so they may not go out. Infants must have outdoor time weather permitting.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: One classroom did not have morning opportunities of outdoor play in the outdoor activity space based on the time indicated on their written activity plan. They went to the gym instead of utilizing the outdoor acitivty space. The weather conditions did not present any inclement weather conditions to prevent them from having outdoor opportunities outside.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The nursery classroom did not have morning opportunities of outdoor play in the outdoor activity space.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Morning outside opportunities were observed at inspection for only 2 out of 4 classrooms. All posted activity plans had appropriate amount of outside time for each age groups but were not being followed. The weather outside was appropriate varying from 75 to 81 degrees during the morning.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The written activity plans for all age groups is not being followed for outdoor activity time. The weather did not present a health risk or inclement weather to prevent children access to their outdoor space but the children were not given any outdoor opportunities in the morning or the afternoon. This was follow up on and none of the children again were taken outside for morning opportunities when the weather was sunny at a temperature of 76 degrees. Additionally one school age classroom as lacking their activity plan being posted and one school age classroom was lacking outdoor opportunities on their activity plan completely.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The written activity plans for all age groups is not being followed for outdoor activity time. The weather did not present a health risk or inclement weather to prevent children access to their outdoor space but the children were not given any outdoor opportunities in the morning or the afternoon.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The daily schedule did not include outdoor play times for morning and afternoon in preschool 1 and toddler rooms. Note: corrected during inspection when schedule updated.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Activity plans were missing outdoor activities, Daily schedule was not available for review.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Outdoor activity times were not listed on the schedule.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Operations activity schedule did not have  a minimum of two daily opportunities for outdoor play, weather permitting, in which a child makes use of both small and large muscles, at the time of inspection.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The director informed me that the children have not gone outside in two months due to the playground area not being safe and currently being remodeled
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Caregivers are not consistently facilitating outdoor play for the children on a daily basis.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The children were not observed having an oprtunity to engage in out door play.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The operation was observed not following the written activity plan by not providing children with outdoor play time.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The children have not been outside since June 2024 for outdoor physical activity.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The daycare doesn't  listed pportunity for outdoor play  on their written activity plan schedule.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: During the monitoring inspection it was observed that one of the classes was playing in the indoor gym rather than outside, even when the weather permitted them to be outside. This was corrected at inspection when the children moved from the gym to play outside.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: A detail outdoor play/safety plan needs to be provided and two opportunities need to be listed for outdoor play.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Two classrooms did not outline outdoor time in the daily schedule.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: It was determined during the inspection that infants are not being taken outside on a daily basis as required.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: During inspection staff stated that a 2 year old child does not have outdoor time, and the child stays inside with another group due to parents request, and there is no doctor note in file.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Activity plans were reviewed and found that there were not 2 planned times for outside play for the children of all ages.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Infants do not go outside.    Toddlers and Pre-K aged children do not go outside for at least 60 minutes a day.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The activity plan for the infant classroom lacks an afternoon opportunity for outdoor play. The current activity plan only displays a morning opportunity for outside play at 10:30 am. Additionally, the afternoon does not include any activities for the infants. The schedule goes from nap time, to snack time and then to dismissal.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Outdoor activity plan only has one opportunity for outdoor play. A minimum of two outdoor opportunities needs to be included in the activity plan.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The daily schedule for infants did not have two daily opportunities for outdoor play.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Infant activity schedule did not include a time for outdoor play.  Infants were observed watching an educational video on an ipad.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The activity plan does not show atleast 90 minutes of vigorous activity for pre- k children. Activity plan updated at inspection
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Written activity plan observed with only one oppurtunity of outdoor time and physical activity in schedule.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The operation does not have a written activity plan for infants in care.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The classrooms are missing daily schedules.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The operation did not have a policy in place that all caregivers knew and were following for taking children outside based on weather conditions. Therefore, children were not being provided proper outdoor play opportunities as shown on the activity plans.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: The activity schedules in the Pre-Kindergarten classrooms did not show opportunities for outdoor time.     This was corrected during the inspection.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Activity plans did not include outdoor activities.     Activity plans for the current week were not posted in three out five classrooms.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Outdoor activities are conducted once a day.      Infant activity plan did not include specific daily activiites.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: During inspection it was observed that children did not have outdoor playtime.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Activity plans were reviewed and do not have the two outside times listed.

Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Activity plans observed in the operation's classrooms did not include outside time for any of the age groups and were not detailed as to the activities the children engage in.
Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: Posted activity plans include outdoor play once daily for children over 12  months of age.
